The first composed build compiled its103 source units, then its target facade compilation observed an older MIndexAST.class without the newly qualified snapshot(int) method. The output class retained an older timestamp while the newly compiled hierarchy class was current. No collaborator reported writing to that output. The cause is not established. The build tool now compiles both phases in one unique temporary output tree and publishes complete jars only after all phases pass. No product source or contract was changed for this build isolation correction.
